query: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'; SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',clock_timestamp(),'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'definition_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)),'body_md5',md5(p.prosrc),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'config',p.proconfig) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid IN('public.promo_apply_playthrough(uuid,uuid,numeric)'::regprocedure))) AS capture; COMMIT;
